data.title: Staff Data Engineer
data.description_html:
About DAT

DAT Freight & Analytics is an award-winning employer of choice and a next-generation SaaS technology company that has been at the leading edge of freight and logistics innovation for nearly five decades. Founded in 1978, DAT operates the largest freight marketplace in North America — processing 250 million+ load posts annually and maintaining one of the largest repositories of freight market transaction data in the world. On a defined path to $1 billion in revenue, DAT deploys a suite of software solutions, machine learning models, and intelligent automation tools that help brokers, carriers, and shippers price freight accurately, source capacity, reduce risk, and operate more efficiently. With nearly 700 teammates across offices in Denver, CO; Portland, OR; Seattle, WA; Springfield, MO; Toronto, ON; and Bangalore, India, DAT combines the credibility of a multi-decade market leader with the drive of a company that is not done disrupting the industry it helped build. For more information, visit www.DAT.com

 

Job Application Deadline: 09/30/2026

 

What You’ll Do

Strategic Architecture & Technical Leadership

  • Platform Evolution: Lead the design and evolution of our modern data platform architecture, ensuring it remains scalable, available, and performant.
  • Pattern Implementation: Apply in-depth knowledge of advanced architectural patterns—such as Event Driven, CQRS, event sourcing, and Saga patterns—to solve complex data challenges.
  • Technical Governance: Develop, document, and communicate standard methods and processes to be utilized within our technology stack, including dbt, Airflow, Snowflake, Kafka, and traditional ETL.
  • Strategic Collaboration: Act as a key partner to senior leadership on strategic data projects and build strong working relationships with other IT leaders by providing technical acumen and thought leadership.

Data Engineering & Distributed Systems

  • Enterprise-Scale Infrastructure: Architect and manage enterprise-scale data platforms while setting best practices for development teams, including security, privacy, monitoring & alerting, and CI/CD.
  • Advanced Data Modeling: Implement sophisticated data modeling strategies, including Kimball, Inmon, or Data Vault, and drive the transition toward modern concepts like Data Mesh.
  • Complex Problem Solving: Provide solutions for complex business problems, enabling insights that can empower better decision-making across the organization.
  • Operational Excellence: Set and enforce best practices for the full software development and technology management life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, and testing.

Mentorship & Culture

  • Culture of Excellence: Take an active role in fostering a culture of learning and excellence within the engineering organization.
  • Influence through Data: Leverage data to prioritize work and influence others across the organization.
  • Change Management: Proactively implement change and improvements when seeing opportunities to optimize the platform or processes.

The Skills and Experience You’ll Bring

  • Experience: 7+ years of relevant professional engineering experience, with a proven track record of building and operating large-scale distributed systems.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

Technical Proficiency:

  • Data Engineering: Strong data engineering background working with dbt, Snowflake, Kafka, and cloud-based services (AWS S3, EMR, Glue).
  • Infrastructure & Tooling: Hands-on experience with Terraform, Airflow, Tableau, MySQL, and Oracle.
  • Software Engineering: Deep knowledge of professional software engineering practices for the full technology management life cycle; experience with Agile is preferred.
  • Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills with an interest in continuous learning and improvement.

Current Technologies Being Used Today:

  • Data Warehouse: Snowflake, Oracle, MySQL
  • Transformation: dbt (data build tool)
  • Orchestration: Apache Airflow
  • Programming: Python, SQL
  • Streaming: Kafka
  • Cloud: AWS (S3, EMR, Glue)
  • Infrastructure: Terraform

 

Why DAT?
DAT is an award winning employer of choice.

For starters, we have a hybrid work environment, but we also know what makes a great workplace. We have a time-tested and resolute set of operating values predicated on integrity, mutual respect, open communication, and executing with excellence. These values inform our strategic vision as much as any one of our products does. We’ve been an employer of choice in the Portland metropolitan area for four decades, and within one year of opening our Denver office, DAT was #26 on Built In Colorado’s 100 Best Places to Work In Colorado.

  • Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, and AD&D insurance
  • Parental Leave
  • Flexible Vacation Time (FVT)
  • An additional 10 holidays of paid time off per calendar year
  • 401k matching (immediately vested)
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Short- and Long-term disability sick leave
  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Health Savings Accounts
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Additional programs - Employee Referral, Internal Recognition, and Wellness

  • Competitive salary and benefits package
  • Work on impactful projects in a cutting-edge environment
  • Collaborative and supportive team culture
  • Opportunity to make a real difference in the trucking industry

*This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship**

For Colorado-based candidates, in compliance with the Colorado Equal Pay for Equal Work Act, the salary range for this role is $134,000.00 - $175,000.00 + target bonus. DAT considers factors such as scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience, education and training, core skills, internal equity, and market and business elements when extending an offer.

 

 

DAT embraces the value of a diverse workforce, and believes it is a core strength of our company that we encourage those values in every DAT employee, at every level of our organization, regardless of tenure or rank. data.title: Influencer Marketing Intern
data.description_html:
Are you discovering emerging creators before everyone else? Are you passionate about the beauty and fragrance industry, and excited to learn everything about influencer marketing? Parfumado is looking for an enthusiastic Influencer Marketing Intern to join our team from September 2026.

Meet Parfumado

At Parfumado, we help our community discover the scents that feel like them - not one signature fragrance forever, but a wardrobe of moods, memories and different versions of yourself. Our ambition is to become Europe’s number-one fragrance discovery platform. With more than 600 fragrances across niche and prestige brands, curated selections and a flexible 8ml format, we make fragrance discovery easy, playful and personal.

We are at an exciting point in our journey: Parfumado is growing internationally, our creator community is expanding and influencer marketing plays a key role in building both our brand awareness and subscriber base. That’s why we’re looking to grow our Influencer Marketing team.

Your role

As an Influencer Marketing Intern, you’ll become a full member of Parfumado’s growing Influencer Marketing team. You’ll help manage a broad range of campaigns - from partnerships with established macro talents to collaborations with emerging micro creators - and contribute directly to growing Parfumado’s growth.

Your natural feel for beauty, social trends and the latest developments within the creator landscape will help you bring fresh ideas and inspiration to the team.

This is a hands-on opportunity to explore every side of influencer marketing, from creator sourcing and campaign coordination to performance analysis and optimisation. It’s perfect for someone who takes initiative, enjoys making things happen and wants to develop quickly within the industry. 

Your impact in this role

  • Help bring influencer campaigns to life across the full project journey - from sourcing and creator selection to briefings, approvals, go-live checks and follow-ups.

  • Keep campaigns moving by coordinating timelines, deliverables and communication with creators and agencies.

  • Manage the backend processes and administrative tasks needed to ensure campaigns run smoothly.

  • Collect and input post-campaign performance data, supporting team reporting and campaign learnings.

  • Work with the team to optimise campaigns by identifying gaps, suggesting improvements and helping boost performance.

  • Turn social trends and campaign results into creative ideas and smarter future collaborations.

Throughout your internship, you’ll gradually take on more responsibility and learn how to build influencer campaigns that deliver both creatively and commercially.

What we offer

  • A monthly internship allowance of €450, based on a full-time internship

  • A hands-on internship where you’ll learn all aspects of influencer marketing

  • Plenty of responsibility and room for your own ideas

  • Guidance from an experienced and ambitious Influencer Marketing team

  • A dynamic environment within a fast-growing, international company

  • Delicious and healthy lunch at the office, free of charge

  • Discounts at Adidas, Zalando, NA-KD and many more through Corporate Benefits

  • Fun team activities, such as padel

  • And, of course, a Parfumado subscription with a perfume of your choice every month!


Requirements

What we’re looking for

  • You are in the final phase of your bachelor’s degree or currently pursuing a master’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications or a related field.

  • You preferably already have internship experience or relevant work experience in influencer marketing, social media, digital marketing or project management.

  • You are professionally fluent in either Dutch or German and have excellent written and spoken English.

  • Knowledge of the Belgian and/or German market and creator landscape is a strong plus.

  • You closely follow developments on TikTok and Instagram and are passionate about creators, beauty, fragrance and digital culture.

  • You are proactive, results-oriented and have a strong can-do mentality.

  • You are organised, detail-oriented and comfortable managing multiple campaigns and deadlines simultaneously.

  • You are comfortable working with Excel and interested in analysing campaign performance.

  • You are creative, eager to learn and confident in taking initiative and sharing your ideas.

Interested?

Great! Send us your CV and a short motivation explaining why influencer marketing and Parfumado are a good match for you. Include your current favourite influencer and an emerging one that would be a great fit with Parfumado. If you have relevant social accounts, projects or previous campaign experience, we’d love to see those too.

Want to learn more about Parfumado as an employer? Visit our website to discover who we are and where we’re heading.

What’s next?

You’ll hear from us within five working days. If we’re excited about your profile, we’ll invite you to a first video call. This will be followed by a case assignment and an interview with the hiring manager. And then… you might become our new Influencer Marketing Intern in September 2026!

data.title: Partner Manager (m/w/d)
data.description_html:
Shopware ist ein führendes E-Commerce-System, das es Unternehmen weltweit ermöglicht, im digitalen Handel schnell und effizient zu skalieren. Als zukunftsweisende Open-Source-Lösung wird Shopware bereits von einigen der größten europäischen Marken, Einzelhändlern und Herstellern im B2C- und B2B-Bereich eingesetzt.

Als Partner Manager (m/w/d) bist du verantwortlich für den strategischen Ausbau unseres Partner-Ökosystems in Deutschland, Österreich und der Schweiz. Du gewinnst neue Digitalagenturen, Systemintegratoren und Solution Partner, entwickelst bestehende Partnerschaften weiter und erschließt gemeinsam mit ihnen neue Geschäftspotenziale.

Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Sales, Marketing und Product zusammen, entwickelst gemeinsame Business- und Go-to-Market-Strategien und trägst zur nachhaltigen Entwicklung von Pipeline und Umsatz bei. Du bist zentrale Ansprechperson für unsere Partner und repräsentierst Shopware aktiv im DACH-E-Commerce-Ökosystem.

Requirements

  • Du verantwortest den strategischen Ausbau und die Weiterentwicklung des Shopware Partner-Ökosystems in der DACH-Region.

  • Du identifizierst, gewinnst und onboardest neue Digitalagenturen, Systemintegratoren und Solution Partner.

  • Du entwickelst bestehende Partnerschaften weiter und erschließt gemeinsam mit unseren Partnern neue Geschäfts- und Wachstumspotenziale.

  • Du verantwortest die Pipeline-Entwicklung deines Partnerportfolios und steuerst gemeinsame Business-Pläne und Performance-Ziele.

  • Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit Sales und Marketing Go-to-Market-Initiativen, Co-Marketing-Aktivitäten und relevante Partner-Events.

  • Du beobachtest den DACH-E-Commerce-Markt und Wettbewerb, identifizierst neue Chancen und baust ein starkes Netzwerk zu relevanten Entscheidern auf.

Das bringst du mit:

  • Du verfügst über mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Partner Management, Channel Sales, Business Development oder in einer vergleichbaren Position.

  • Du hast nachweisbare Erfahrung im Aufbau und in der Weiterentwicklung von Partnerschaften sowie in der gemeinsamen Generierung von Pipeline und Geschäft.

  • Du kennst den DACH-E-Commerce-Markt und verfügst idealerweise über ein Netzwerk zu Digitalagenturen, Systemintegratoren oder relevanten Commerce-Partnern.

  • Du verbindest strategisches Denken mit einer Hands-on-Mentalität und arbeitest selbstständig, strukturiert und unternehmerisch.

  • Du überzeugst durch starke Kommunikations-, Präsentations- und Verhandlungsfähigkeiten und bewegst dich sicher auf unterschiedlichen Stakeholder-Ebenen.

  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

Das bieten wir dir:

  • Unternehmenskultur: Offene Kultur, flache Hierarchien, Eigeninitiative wird gefördert.

  • Arbeitsverträge: Unbefristete Anstellungen bieten langfristige Sicherheit.

  • Flexibilität: Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Optionen für mobiles Arbeiten und Full-Remote-Verträge.

  • Ausstattung: Freie Wahl der Arbeits-Hardware.

  • Onboarding: Gut strukturiertes Onboarding mit Unterstützung durch einen persönlichen "Buddy".

  • Arbeitsumfeld: Inspirierendes Umfeld mit engagierten Kollegen und einer dynamischen Gemeinschaft.

  • Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten: Vielfältige Chancen für persönliches Wachstum und Entwicklung.

  • Zusatzleistungen: Attraktive Benefits wie betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Gesundheitsprogramme und regelmäßige Teamevents.

... und vieles mehr!
Einen detaillierten Einblick bekommst du auf unserer Karriereseite.

Deine Ansprechperson für diese Stelle ist Yanina Schröer und steht dir bei Fragen gerne zur Verfügung!

Alle unsere Positionen stehen selbstverständlich auch Menschen mit Behinderung offen.

data.title: Security Engineer (ITSec) (m,f,x)
data.description_html:
The role

We’re looking for a new teammate to join us on the journey of keeping HelloFresh a trusted name - someone with a passion for security and appetite for new challenges. Security Engineers work in a variety of ways to constantly iterate and improve HelloFresh’s security posture. 

You will be the first port of call for responding to any of HelloFresh’s security related questions and concerns. You will also develop and deliver tools and processes to enable colleagues to achieve their goals and objectives.

Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

What you’ll do

  • Enhance the security posture of the enterprise IT infrastructure, services, and tools by hardening them against abuse and nefarious activity
  • Implement secure configurations and policies for IAM, EDR, VPN, Firewalls, Email Security, Slack and MDM tools
  • Responsible for security hardening and posture of enterprise IT assets
  • Adapt to modern AI adoption strategy through implementing and mitigating AI controls in a variety of methods including Shadow AI, MCP integrations, and protecting against AI-based risks.
  • Deploy, optimize and operate modern security solutions like EDR, Zero-Trust, SSE/CASB, DLP, and Patch Management tools.
  • Assist in company-wide security awareness campaigns and vulnerability patching.
  • Perform comparative technical and commercial analysis for various security products/tools prior to procurement

What you’ll bring

  • Hands-on experience hardening workstations, network equipment, servers, IAM platforms through using CIS/NIST frameworks
  • Understanding and usage of Generative AI from a corporate perspective, including LLM guardrails, MCP connections/gateways, and risks stemming from its usage such as prompt injections
  • Ability to perform malware analysis on Windows, MacOS, and Linux machines
  • Understanding of modern-day social engineering attacks and how to prevent them through technical controls and training
  • In-depth understanding of common TCP/IP protocols and modern-day security threats on each network layer and protecting against them
  • Good communication and reporting skills

What we offer

Elevate your lifestyle! Join one of Europe's fastest-growing tech powerhouses in a dynamic phase of expansion.

  • Immerse yourself in a diverse global community of 90+ nationalities.
  • Enjoy a competitive compensation package that goes beyond the norm, with perks like a HelloFresh- subsidized Pension Scheme and a Hybrid working model.
  • Elevate your lifestyle with exclusive discounts on your weekly HelloFresh box and office meals.
  • Invest in your growth with a German language learning budget, and access to the HelloFresh Academy.
  • Plus, we've got your well-being covered with mental health support, transportation perks, and working-parent-friendly benefits. From our 24/7 gym access,wellbeing platforms like Headspace and Spill, to sabbatical leave options, HelloFresh is not just a workplace; it's a lifestyle of perks and possibilities!

data.title: Executive Assistant to Group CEO
data.description_html:
Job Title: Executive Assistant

Location: Radius Campus HQ, 08:30am - 5pm, in office 5-days per week

An exciting opportunity has arisen for an Executive Assistant to join our Executive Operations team, supporting our Group CEO.

Reporting to the Head of Executive Operations, you will play a key part in the smooth running of the Group CEO’s office, supporting diary management, travel, meeting coordination and administration. You will work closely with, and under the guidance of, the Head of Executive Operations, who will set priorities and support you in the role.

This is an excellent opportunity for a Personal Assistant or Executive Assistant with two to four years’ experience who is ready to step into a high-profile role at the heart of a global business, with the mentoring and development to grow into a senior Executive Assistant position over time.

We will be happy to welcome you to our Campus HQ Crewe, with core working hours of Monday to Friday from 8.30 am to 5.00 pm. Given the profile of the office you will support, some flexibility to provide support outside core hours will occasionally be required.

Your daily responsibilities will be...

  • Supporting the day-to-day management of the Group CEO’s diary under the guidance of the Head of Executive Operations, scheduling meetings, resolving clashes and keeping the diary accurate and up to date.
  • Monitoring and triaging correspondence into the Group CEO’s office, drafting straightforward responses and escalating items to the Head of Executive Operations where appropriate.
  • Arranging and coordinating UK and international travel, accommodation and detailed itineraries, and processing related expenses.
  • Assisting with the preparation and collation of the CEO pack and other board and executive materials, working to the direction of the Head of Executive Operations.
  • Helping to organise offsites, events and business meetings, including venues, logistics, catering and attendees.
  • Attending meetings to take notes and capture actions where required, and following up to ensure they are completed.
  • Maintaining accurate records, contact lists, distribution lists and filing for the Group CEO’s office.
  • Handling confidential and sensitive information with absolute discretion and sound judgement.
  • Building effective working relationships with colleagues and external contacts, always representing the Group CEO’s office professionally.
  • Providing support to the Head of Executive Operations and the wider EA community as required, including occasional cover and ad hoc project work.
  • Two to four years’ experience as a Personal Assistant, Executive Assistant, team assistant or in a similar administrative support role.
  • Strong academics, with degree-level education and/or relevant professional qualifications.
  • Excellent diary management and scheduling skills, with confident use of Microsoft Outlook and the wider Microsoft 365 suite.
  • Strong organisational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-moving environment.
  • Clear and professional written and verbal communication skills.
  • A mature, professional approach and the confidence to interact with senior stakeholders.
  • Discretion and sound judgement when handling confidential and sensitive matters.
  • Some experience of travel planning and logistics would be an advantage, although support and training will be provided.
  • Proactive, self-motivated and calm under pressure, with a positive and flexible approach to changing demands.
  • A genuine appetite to learn, take feedback and develop into a senior Executive Assistant over time.
  • Flexibility and willingness to provide support outside core hours when the role requires it.

Benefits:

  • A friendly culture that mirrors our proposition to our customers. 
  • A fast-growing organisation that defines itself as being agile and innovative
  • A drive for continuous improvement, which you will be empowered to get behind from day one. 
  • A commitment to building a working environment that values inclusivity, innovation, agility, and drive.
  • 25 days holiday + Bank Holidays
  • Employee Fuel Card
  • Retail Discounts
  • Health and Wellbeing support services

 

Diversity, Equality & Inclusion at Radius

Our global DEI networks champion LGBTQ+ inclusion, cultural diversity, women’s empowerment and mental health, neurodiversity and disability support.

We also offer:

  • Global Female Health Policy & Female Health Champions
  • Pregnancy Loss and Fertility Treatment Policies
  • Endometriosis Friendly Employer (UK)
  • Women-focused gym & female health events
  • Mental Health First Aiders
  • Disability Confident Committed Employer (Level 1)
  • Race at Work Charter signatory
  • Proud sponsor of Crewe Pride (5 years running) and Cheshire Pride Awards Corporate Supporter 2025
  • Community network driving charity and volunteering initiatives, with 8 consecutive years of participation in the UK Challenge.

Next Steps

If you feel we are a good match for each other, you can apply online now!

If you’d like to understand more about the role or life at Radius before applying, then please contact our talent team directly.

Emergent builds autonomous coding agents that replace traditional software development by generating, testing, and deploying production applications directly from plain-language intent. Our systems run in production at global scale and are used to build millions of real applications.

Since our public launch, we've crossed $100M in ARR and grown to over 10M users across 190+ countries, who have built 12M+ applications on Emergent. We're backed by Creaegis, Claypond, Sentinel Global, Khosla Ventures, SoftBank, Google, Lightspeed, Prosus, Together, and Y Combinator.

We're solving the hard part of AI-driven software creation: correctness, reliability, security, and scale in real production systems. The team is built by repeat founders, Olympiad medalists, IIT & IIM alumni, and leaders from Google, Amazon, and Dropbox.

We're hiring builders who want ownership, speed, and impact at global scale.

About the Role

You will be responsible for developing and deploying key autonomy functions within our interceptor platform, focusing on Guidance, Navigation & Target Tracking, or Control. From algorithm development and system integration to flight testing and field debugging, you will help deliver reliable autonomous capabilities in demanding operational environments.

What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Depending on your background and expertise, your primary focus will be in Guidance, Navigation, or Control. You will take ownership of one of these areas while working closely with engineers across the broader GNC stack to deliver a reliable autonomous interceptor system.

    • Guidance: Develop and deploy guidance algorithms that convert mission objectives and estimated vehicle and target states/predictions into feasible control commands. Develop predictive approaches that account for target motion and maneuvers.

    • Navigation & Target Tracking: Develop and integrate state-estimation, sensor-fusion, and target-approaches that provide reliable states and short-horizon predictions, including sensor fusion and uncertainty modeling.

    • Control: Develop and tune flight-control algorithms that translate guidance commands into stable, responsive, and feasible aircraft behavior across the operating envelope. 

      Across all three focus areas, you will:

    • Integration: Integrate algorithms with perception, flight-control, simulation, and operator systems through ROS 2, MAVLink, and related interfaces.

    • Benchmarking and Validation: Validate performance through simulation, recorded-data replay, SITL/HITL, and flight testing. 

    • Field Debugging: Analyze real logs, reproduce failures, isolate root causes, and improve the system until it works not only on your machine, but in the field. 

Requirements

What You Bring to the Team

  • You’re structured, fast-moving, and a team player. You iterate fast and work with a high degree of autonomy. You love building things that last and analyze and fix root cause problems over applying short-term patches. 

  • Degree in robotics, aerospace, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, applied mathematics, computer vision, or a comparable technical field.

  • Several years of hands-on experience in the field. We also consider relevant experience gained through student clubs, internships, or working-student positions. 

  • Strong fundamentals in guidance, control, vehicle kinematics and dynamics, state estimation, optimization, and dynamical systems, with deep expertise in at least one of these areas.

  • Strong implementation skills in C++ or Rust and experience with ROS 2.

  • Good understanding of coordinate frames, quaternions, NED/ENU conventions, timing, and filtering. 

  • Experience with interception or predictive guidance, PID or model-based control, trajectory optimization, or model-predictive approaches.

  • Experience with PX4, ArduPilot, MAVLink, or similar flight-control ecosystems.

  • Experience with system identification, flight-dynamics modeling, target tracking, or GNSS-denied navigation.

  • Experience with simulation, SITL/HITL, flight-log analysis, structured flight testing, or multi-vehicle autonomy.

Why Join Quantum-Systems?

  • Be at the forefront of next-generation Defence innovation.

  • Work in a fast-paced, agile environment where your ideas make an impact.

  • Collaborate with a team of industry pioneers who are ambitious, bold, and visionary.

  • Opportunities for individual and professional growth in a globally recognized organization.

About us:

Quantum Systems specializes in the development, design, and production of small Unmanned Aerial Systems (sUAS). The company’s range of electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) sUAS are built to maximize range and versatility and to provide operators with a seamless user experience. By integrating cutting-edge software capabilities, like edge computing and real-time AI-powered data processing, Quantum Systems is building next-generation UAS for clients in the defense, security, and public sectors.

How to Apply

Please include as your cover letter:

  • A detailed description of your hands-on projects, including photos, GitHub links, and videos, drawings.

data.title: Junior IT Specialist
data.description_html:
At Bondora, our mission is simple: to make finance easy, transparent, and accessible for everyone.

Founded in 2008, we’ve helped more than 700,000 customers across Europe borrow and invest effortlessly through our trusted digital products.

As a rapidly growing financial technology company, we’re reaching new heights with a bold vision. We’re set to acquire a banking license, unlocking a world of possibilities for our customers. This transition will allow us to expand our lending across more EU countries and broaden our product suite to deliver even more value.

Join us on this journey and let’s build the future of finance together!

What is this role about?

As a Junior IT Specialist, you’ll play a key role in ensuring first-line IT support via Jira Service Desk and Slack, as well as in person. You will onboard and off board employees (accounts, hardware, access),  troubleshoot hardware, software, and network issues, and manage IT asset inventory and hardware lifecycle.

A working knowledge of computers and IT is required, as you’ll work across Windows, macOS, Microsoft 365 suite, Atlassian Jira and Confluence, federated identity management systems (Entra ID), Mobile Device Management systems and so on. Collaboration is crucial as this role requires you to work closely with Engineering, People, and Security teams on cross-team initiatives.

This position requires a combination of IT skills and ability to work with cross-functional teams on a daily basis:

  • Ensure the IT warehouse and tech stock are cleaned out and restructured
  • Prepare and run registration, installation and maintenance of laptops and office IT systems
  • Adapt and function in an AI-first environment with modern technology and a varied body of work 
  • Monitor and ensure that the hardware inventory is up to date and verified
  • Maintain accurate documentation of IT solutions and documented knowledge base

This role is in Tallinn, and Estonian language proficiency is highly desirable.

What would ensure success in this role?

Success in this role is determined by IT expertise, process optimisation, and asset management. The ideal candidate will have:

  • Proven experience working with Jira and other SaaS (Software as a Service) products
  • Strong skills in IT 
  • Ability to adapt to changing priorities and system requirements
  • Experience with multiple operating systems and computers
  • Ability to collaborate and coordinate efficiently 

What can you expect at Bondora? 

  • Contribute to Bondora’s ambitious goal of reaching €1bn in revenue. Your skills and efforts will directly impact our growth trajectory and shape the future of our company

  • Our employees deserve the best. We recognize our people with a competitive salary and a generous benefits package (5 weeks of vacation, private healthcare compensation, hobby grant, mental healthcare support, share options and much more!)

  • We provide an environment that encourages your personal and professional growth. As we constantly evolve and innovate, you’ll have endless opportunities (and budget) to expand your skills and skyrocket your career

The next steps:

If you have the guts, ideas, and a team vision, apply now! 

Our hiring process: 

  • Meet Ariba Zaidi, our Recruiter: Your first interview with Ariba will give you the chance to share your experiences and aspirations
  • Meet with Urmo Laaneots, our Hiring Manager: You can explore more about the role and ask questions about how you can make an impact
  • Put your skills to the test: Tackle a take-home task related to IT skills - allowing you to show us how you think and act in real-time 
  • Collaborate with Urmo - to review your take-home task submission: Go over your submission with the Hiring Manager and share your perspective
  • Complete our assessments: Our personality and logic assessments will help us understand your strengths
  • Final Interview - Martin Sulg: Engage with our VP of Engineering to cover remaining topics 
  • Bar-raiser Interview  - Tarmo Protsin: An independent evaluation step and the last one with our Chief Architect 
  • The celebration begins: If the stars align, receive an offer to join the Bondora team! 
 
This is a hybrid role that requires the candidate to be located in Tallinn, Estonia. 
 

 

Join our team of Bondorians, and let's make it happen!

If you'd like to read how Bondora collects, uses, and protects your personal data during recruitment, please see HERE.

data.description_html:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.  

 

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

 

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to Know our Team:  

The People Team is a purveyor of opportunity, searching the globe for the most talented individuals and offering them an open, collaborative workplace. By prioritizing skill and potential, we have cultivated a powerful assembly of professionals through our drive for equal opportunity and diversity. We make the move to Agoda a breeze with assisted onboarding programs, and we continue to support and enrich our thousands of Agoda employees through individual growth with outstanding learning programs and various means of assistance. Our development of incredible benefits has ensured everyone can stay strong, healthy, and happy during their time at Agoda. Leading ambitious changes and making a positive impact in the lives of our employees, the People Team is a crucial and rewarding part of the Agoda family.  

The Opportunity 

We are looking for a Talent Acquisition Partner who will help us strategically yet grow our world-class team in India and other countries across the globe. You should be passionate about recruiting first-rate talents that will add value to the business. Partnering with senior management (including Country Director/SR Director/AD), you will be critical to creating a seamless recruiting process to help Agoda scale our business globally. 

In this Role, you'll get to 

  • Partner with hiring managers to understand their business objectives and hiring needs. Develop the recruitment strategy and ways to build a talent pipeline accordingly. 
  • Own the full-cycle recruitment process ensuring a seamless, uniform, and positive candidate experience. 
  • Build your network with high-potential talents to ensure that the business has access to the best talent in the market, working comfortably on a global level. 
  • Engage in creative talent mapping efforts for the purposes of building our candidate pipeline as well as to provide market intelligence to the business. 
  • Work on recruitment projects and training to improve the standard for hiring within the organization 

Must-Have

-A strong problem-solving mindset, with the ability to identify root causes, propose practical solutions, and create clear action plans when pipelines are challenging.
-Experience hiring across different levels, from early-career talent through to leadership roles, including negotiating complex compensation packages and successfully closing candidates.
-A data-driven approach, with the ability to analyze recruitment metrics, generate useful insights, and translate them into recommendations for Japan leaders.
-Excellent communication, listening, presentation, and relationship-building skills.
-Strong proficiency with recruitment and productivity tools, such as LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, Greenhouse, and Microsoft Office.
-A proactive and continuous-improvement mindset, with the ability to identify opportunities and drive recruitment process improvements.
-A passion for recruitment and delivering an excellent candidate experience.

- Proficiency in Japanese and English is required

Good-to-Have
-Experience in both agency and in-house recruitment environments.
-Experience partnering with senior leadership on strategic recruitment initiatives.

data.title: Working Student Export Control & Trade Compliance (all genders)
data.description_html:
About Us

STARK is a new kind of defence technology company. We design, develop, and manufacture high-performance unmanned systems that are software-defined, mass-scalable, and cost-effective, changing how autonomous systems are deployed across multiple domains. This gives our operators a decisive edge in highly contested environments. As threats rise, STARK is strengthening the technological edge of NATO Allies and their Partners to deter aggression and defend Europe.

About the team

Du wirst Teil unseres Teams an der Schnittstelle zwischen internationalem Handel, Exportkontrolle und dem operativen Tagesgeschäft bei STARK. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen aus verschiedenen Bereichen wie Vertrieb, Einkauf und Logistik zusammen. Von Anfang an arbeitest du an realen Fällen und sammelst praktische Erfahrung in einem schnelllebigen internationalen Umfeld.

Your mission

Als Werkstudent im Bereich Exportkontrolle unterstützt du uns dabei, nationale und internationale Exportkontrollvorgaben zuverlässig in unsere täglichen Geschäftsprozesse zu integrieren.

Du arbeitest eng mit verschiedenen Fachabteilungen wie Vertrieb, Einkauf und Logistik zusammen und unterstützt bei konkreten Fragestellungen rund um Exportgenehmigungen, Sanktionen, Güterklassifizierungen und länderbezogene Restriktionen.

Dabei erhältst du direkten Einblick in reale Fälle des internationalen Handels- und Exportkontrollrechts und kannst dein theoretisches Wissen unmittelbar in der Praxis anwenden.

Responsibilities

  • Du beantwortest tägliche Fragen aus Fachabteilungen, zum Beispiel Vertrieb, Einkauf und Logistik, zu exportkontrollrelevanten Abläufen und Prüfschritten.
  • Du unterstützt aktiv bei der Vorbereitung und Ausarbeitung von Ausfuhrgenehmigungsanträgen beim Bundesamt für Wirtschaft und Ausfuhrkontrolle (BAFA).
  • Vor geplanten Exporten führst du Recherchen zu Exportgenehmigungen, Sanktionen, Güterklassifizierungen und länderbezogenen Restriktionen durch.
  • Du analysierst und dokumentierst vergangene Ausfuhr- und Zolldaten zur Risikoanalyse und zur Vorbereitung interner und externer Audits.
  • Du erstellst, prüfst und verwaltest eigenverantwortlich Endverbleibserklärungen für Kunden, Lieferanten und Behörden.


Qualifications

  • Du bist immatrikulierter Student (all genders) im Bereich Wirtschaftsrecht, Rechtswissenschaften, BWL, Logistik, International Business oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung.
  • Du verfügst über ein grundlegendes Verständnis oder starkes Interesse am deutschen und europäischen Exportkontrollrecht, insbesondere AWG/AWV und der EU-Dual-Use-Verordnung.
  • Du hast Freude daran, komplexe Regelungen verständlich zu vermitteln und deine Kolleginnen und Kollegen lösungsorientiert zu unterstützen.
  • Du arbeitest sehr sorgfältig, strukturiert und eigenverantwortlich.
  • Du verfügst über verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse und sehr gute Englischkenntnisse.

Nice to have

Erste praktische Erfahrungen im Bereich Exportkontrolle, Zoll, Compliance oder Außenwirtschaft, zum Beispiel durch Praktika oder Werkstudententätigkeiten

data.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer (Python & React)
data.description_html:
Suvoda is seeking a skilled and driven Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer to help build and evolve a reporting web application used to view, query, download, and schedule delivery of reports. You'll own features end to end: a Python backend and a React/TypeScript frontend.

 

What Should You Expect?

 

Responsibilities:

Backend:

- Design and build backend services using Python and a modern web framework (e.g. FastAPI), exposing REST APIs consumed by the frontend and other client applications.

- Implement authentication and authorization: SSO integration, session/token handling, and role/permission-based access control.

- Implement audit logging for key user actions (who/when/what/why) and change tracking across core data.

- Build and maintain scheduling and background job features (e.g. cron-based schedules, retries, status tracking).

- Own database schema design and changes, using a migration tool to manage schema evolution.

- Write automated backend tests and uphold code quality and linting standards as part of a test-driven workflow.

 

Frontend:

- Design and build UI features in React and TypeScript, covering configuration screens, data views, and dashboards.

- Build interactive dashboards and data grids, including custom, user-configurable layouts.

- Implement frontend session handling and permission-aware UI (hide/disable actions the current user isn't allowed to perform).

- Own the full request lifecycle for a feature — from API contract design, through backend implementation, to the frontend components and state management that consume it.

- Write frontend component/integration tests and maintain type safety.

 

AI Features:

- Build and maintain AI-powered features (e.g. an in-app AI assistant panel, AI-driven insights/recommendations) on both the API and UI layers.

- Integrate with LLM/AI services through approved, governed integrations — respecting data-handling policies (no confidential or customer data sent to non-approved services) and keeping AI output reviewable/attributable to a human rather than auto-applied.

- Use AI coding assistants (e.g. GitHub Copilot, Claude Code) as part of the day-to-day development workflow to speed up delivery while maintaining code quality and test coverage.

 

Platform & Delivery:

- Containerize and deploy services (e.g. Docker, Kubernetes/Helm) across multiple environments.

- Provision and manage cloud infrastructure as code using Terraform.

- Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions: automated tests, security scanning, image builds, and deployment automation.

- Collaborate with product, engineering, and QA to deliver reusable, secure solutions, and support code quality, observability, and API design best practices.

 

Requirements:

- Bachelor's degree in a technical field such as Computer Science or a related discipline.

- At least 7 years of experience in full-stack software engineering, with demonstrated ownership of production systems spanning backend and frontend.

- Strong proficiency in Python, including experience building production REST APIs and working with an ORM.

- Strong proficiency in React and TypeScript, including hooks-based components, client-side data fetching/caching, and routing.

- Strong SQL skills and experience with relational data modeling.

- Understanding of authentication/authorization patterns (SSO, tokens/JWT) and role-based permission models, implemented consistently across API and UI layers.

- Experience with containerization and CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions or similar).

- Working knowledge of infrastructure-as-code (Terraform or similar).

- Comfortable using AI coding assistants (e.g. GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor) in daily development, and able to critically review AI-generated code rather than accept it blindly.

- Strong communication and collaboration skills, comfortable owning a feature end to end across backend and frontend.
